classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve and analyze representative UniProt sequences annotated with GO:0052855 activity, then explicitly submit the top representative candidate; final response must include Reason: and Answer: where Answer is the selected amino-acid sequence.
assumptions: GO:0052855 is a resolvable GO molecular function term; literature_search will surface it as the leading GO constraint so go_sequences can use it directly.
UniProt contains at least one reviewed or unreviewed entry annotated to GO:0052855 within the default sequence length range.
sequence_analysis will identify at least one representative_sequence from the retrieved FASTA, which serves as the Answer field.
The Reason field will be populated from the family characterization summary (composition, pI, GRAVY, dominant motifs) produced by sequence_analysis.
No target structure or hotspot residues are needed; a semantic family representative is the requested output.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.
